ModMetaData.name: Solace
ModMetaData.author: T&B Modding
ModMetaData.description:
Every mod that touches a colonist's head makes things worse. This one is the other direction.
Colonists who are struggling can be sat with. It is not a cure and it is not free.
Comfort - A colonist near their breaking point can be comforted by someone who thinks well of them. They feel better for it, and the two of them grow closer. - How much it helps depends on the comforter: their social skill, whether they are Kind, and how much they actually care about the person in front of them. - Children are comforted, and can comfort in turn.
It costs the comforter - Sitting with someone in a bad way takes something out of you. The comforter carries a little of it themselves for a day or two. - Do it over and over and it tells on them. This is deliberate: a colony cannot run one person as its emotional dumping ground for free.
Hollow comfort - A Sociopath will go through the motions perfectly well. It lifts the mood and heals nothing underneath. - A Psychopath does not bother.
Steadied - Enough comfort over time leaves a colonist genuinely steadier: a lower breaking point for a while, marked in their health tab. - It has to be earned repeatedly. It fades if the colony stops looking after its people.
Works with Grief: being comforted genuinely moves mourning along, not just the mood on top of it. Grief is not required.
This mod only changes how colonists feel. It never changes how anyone aims, works or chooses a job.
Requires Harmony. Safe to add to an existing save. RimWorld 1.6, no DLC needed.
